title: is_begin_line matches 'beginning...' at line start — InvalidBeginLine false positive
description:
Trigger: input text containing a prose line that starts with 'begin' but is NOT followed by whitespace, e.g. 'beginners guide to Linux
' or 'beginning of part 2
'. is_begin_line now checks only the first 5 bytes (b"begin"), so any such line triggers handle_block. parse_begin_line returns None (because the char after 'begin' is not whitespace), causing Err(InvalidBeginLine{ line: "beginners guide to Linux" }) to be emitted. Old behavior: is_begin_line required b"begin " (6 chars with space), so these lines were silently ignored. New behavior causes spurious InvalidBeginLine errors for any prose text starting a line with 'begin' followed by a non-space character. Fix: is_begin_line should check that after the 5-byte 'begin' prefix, the next byte is either whitespace, end-of-line, or '-' (for begin-base64). Or: tighten is_begin_line back to 'begin ' (with space), since bare 'begin
' is so rare and broken that emitting no result for it is acceptable.
close_reason: Fixed: is_begin_line now requires the byte after 'begin' to be whitespace or '-'; prose lines like 'beginners...' no longer trigger InvalidBeginLine.
